## Cloud-init generation

[`vps_init()`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#vps_init)
builds a cloud-init YAML for a fresh VPS via
`fastcloudinit.cloud_init_config`: UFW hardening, user creation, SSH key
setup, optional Docker.
[`multi_init()`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#multi_init)
is the local equivalent via `cloud_init_base` — same Docker setup, no
UFW, no fail2ban.

### multi_init

``` python
def multi_init(
    hostname, pub_keys:NoneType=None, username:str='deploy', docker:bool=True, pkgs:NoneType=None,
    cmds:NoneType=None
):
```

*Cloud-init for Multipass local VMs. pub_keys=None → auto-generates
ed25519 key pair. Returns AttrDict(yaml, key).*

``` python
# explicit pub_keys → no key generated, key=None
ci = multi_init('mylocal', 'ssh-rsa AAAA...')
assert '#cloud-config' in ci.yaml and 'get.docker.com' in ci.yaml and 'ufw' not in ci.yaml
assert 'power_state' in ci.yaml and ci.key is None
print(ci.yaml)

# auto-generate mode: key pair written to ~/.ssh/mylocal{,.pub}
ci2 = multi_init('mylocal', docker=False)
assert 'get.docker.com' not in ci2.yaml and 'power_state' not in ci2.yaml
assert ci2.key is not None and ci2.key.exists()
assert Path(str(ci2.key) + '.pub').exists()
ci2.key.unlink(); Path(str(ci2.key) + '.pub').unlink()
print('multi_init OK')
```

## Lightsail (boto3)

[`Lightsail`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#lightsail)
has the same shape as
[`Hetzner`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#hetzner)
(`servers`, `get`, `server_ip`, `create`, `delete`) over the boto3
Lightsail client, so
[`vps_deploy`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#vps_deploy)
works with either. boto3 is an optional extra:
`pip install 'vpseasy[aws]'`. Credentials come from the standard AWS
chain (e.g. `AWS_PROFILE` from SSO). `create()` is idempotent, attaches
a static IP, opens only port 22 (traffic arrives through the Cloudflare
tunnel) and enables daily automatic snapshots.

Lightsail runs user data as a shell launch script, not as cloud-config,
so `create()` converts
[`vps_init()`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#vps_init)
YAML with
[`cloud_init_sh()`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#cloud_init_sh):
a POSIX script that applies the same settings (hostname, users with sudo
and SSH keys, write_files, apt conf, packages, runcmd), keeps the YAML
in `/var/lib/vpseasy/cloud-config.yaml`, logs to
`/var/log/vpseasy-init.log` and touches `/var/lib/vpseasy/ready` (or
`error`), which
[`chk_cloud_init()`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#chk_cloud_init)
reads. Re-running cloud-init with the YAML in `/etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d`
was tried on Ubuntu 24.04 and did not create users, so it is not used.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/vedicreader/vpseasy/blob/main/vpseasy/core.py#L154"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### cloud_init_sh

``` python
def cloud_init_sh(
    cloud_init
):
```

*POSIX shell equivalent of a vps_init() cloud-config, for providers that
run user data as a script (Lightsail).* Skips power_state (no reboot),
preserve_hostname and disable_root (root login is already off on Ubuntu
images).

### Lightsail

``` python
def Lightsail(
    region:str='ap-southeast-2', profile:NoneType=None
):
```

*AWS Lightsail VPS provider via boto3. Credentials from the AWS chain
(e.g. AWS_PROFILE from SSO).*

``` python
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_fail
y = vps_init('lh', 'ssh-ed25519 AAAATEST lh').yaml
ud = cloud_init_sh(y)
subprocess.run(['bash', '-n'], input=ud, text=True, check=True)
assert ud.startswith('#!/bin/bash\n') and y.rstrip() in ud
assert "useradd -m -s /bin/bash deploy" in ud and 'ssh-ed25519 AAAATEST lh' in ud and 'deploy ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' in ud
assert 'get.docker.com' in ud and 'ufw --force enable' in ud and ud.rstrip().endswith('touch /var/lib/vpseasy/ready')
assert '--force-confold' in ud and 'PasswordAuthentication no' in ud and 'rm -f /var/lib/vpseasy/error' in ud
body = ud[ud.index('hostnamectl'):]
assert body.index('useradd') < body.index('apt-get') < body.index('get.docker.com')
test_fail(lambda: cloud_init_sh('#cloud-config\nbootcmd: [echo hi]\n'), contains='bootcmd')
# users: 'default' skipped, comma-separated groups, unknown sub-keys rejected
u = cloud_init_sh("#cloud-config\nusers: [default, {name: bob, groups: 'sudo, docker'}]\n")
assert 'usermod -aG sudo,docker bob' in u and 'default' not in u.split('VPSEASY_EOF')[-1]
test_fail(lambda: cloud_init_sh('#cloud-config\nusers: [{name: bob, lock_passwd: true}]\n'), contains='lock_passwd')
# write_files: int modes converted, bad modes rejected, owner quoted
w = cloud_init_sh("#cloud-config\nwrite_files: [{path: /etc/x, content: hi, permissions: 0600, owner: 'a b'}]\n")
assert 'chmod 600 /etc/x' in w and "chown 'a b' /etc/x" in w
test_fail(lambda: cloud_init_sh("#cloud-config\nwrite_files: [{path: /etc/x, permissions: '0644; rm -rf /'}]\n"), contains='permissions')
```

``` python
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_fail
from botocore.stub import Stubber
ls = Lightsail(region='ap-southeast-2')
st = Stubber(ls._c)
def inst(state='running', ip='3.1.2.3'): return {'instance': {'name': 'lh', 'state': {'name': state}, **({'publicIpAddress': ip} if ip else {})}}

# servers() lists name/ip/status
st.add_response('get_instances', {'instances': [inst()['instance']]})
with st: test_eq(ls.servers(), [dict(name='lh', ip='3.1.2.3', status='running')])

# server_ip waits through pending
st.add_response('get_instance', inst('pending', None), {'instanceName': 'lh'})
st.add_response('get_instance', inst(), {'instanceName': 'lh'})
with st: test_eq(ls.server_ip('lh', interval=0), '3.1.2.3')

# create() is idempotent: an existing instance is returned, create_instances never called
st.add_response('get_instance', inst(), {'instanceName': 'lh'})
st.add_response('get_instance', inst(), {'instanceName': 'lh'})
with st: r = ls.create('lh', cloud_init='#cloud-config\n', static_ip=False, ports=None, snapshots=None)
test_eq(r.ip, '3.1.2.3')

# get() returns None for a missing instance
st.add_client_error('get_instance', service_error_code='NotFoundException', expected_params={'instanceName': 'nope'})
with st: test_eq(ls.get('nope'), None)
st.assert_no_pending_responses()
```

``` python
# full create: static IP already allocated (re-run) is reused, then attached; ports and snapshots configured
st = Stubber(ls._c)
st.add_client_error('get_instance', service_error_code='NotFoundException', expected_params={'instanceName': 'lh'})
st.add_response('create_instances', {'operations': []}, {'instanceNames': ['lh'], 'availabilityZone': 'ap-southeast-2a',
                'blueprintId': 'ubuntu_24_04', 'bundleId': 'small_3_2', 'userData': cloud_init_sh('#cloud-config\n')})
st.add_response('get_instance', inst(), {'instanceName': 'lh'})
st.add_client_error('allocate_static_ip', service_error_code='InvalidInputException', service_message='Static IP already in use')
st.add_response('attach_static_ip', {'operations': []}, {'staticIpName': 'lh-ip', 'instanceName': 'lh'})
st.add_response('get_static_ip', {'staticIp': {'name': 'lh-ip', 'ipAddress': '13.5.5.5'}}, {'staticIpName': 'lh-ip'})
st.add_response('put_instance_public_ports', {'operation': {}}, {'instanceName': 'lh', 'portInfos': [dict(fromPort=22, toPort=22, protocol='tcp')]})
st.add_response('enable_add_on', {'operations': []}, {'resourceName': 'lh', 'addOnRequest': {'addOnType': 'AutoSnapshot', 'autoSnapshotAddOnRequest': {'snapshotTimeOfDay': '16:00'}}})
with st: r = ls.create('lh', cloud_init='#cloud-config\n')
test_eq(r.ip, '13.5.5.5')
st.assert_no_pending_responses()

# server_ip never returns None: an instance stuck in pending times out
st.add_response('get_instance', inst('pending', None), {'instanceName': 'lh'})
with st: test_fail(lambda: ls.server_ip('lh', tout=0.05, interval=0.1), exc=TimeoutError)
```

``` python
# bucket(): created when missing, fresh access key each call
st = Stubber(ls._c)
st.add_client_error('get_buckets', service_error_code='NotFoundException', expected_params={'bucketName': 'lh-backups'})
st.add_response('create_bucket', {'bucket': {'name': 'lh-backups'}, 'operations': []}, {'bucketName': 'lh-backups', 'bundleId': 'small_1_0'})

with st: test_eq(ls.bucket('lh-backups').key_id, 'AKIAEXAMPLE000000002')
st.assert_no_pending_responses()
```

[`deploy()`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#deploy)
syncs a Compose stack to a remote host and brings it up.

``` python
assert _ssh('1.2.3.4', 'deploy', '/k', 2222)[-3:] == ['-p', '2222', 'deploy@1.2.3.4']
assert '-i' in _ssh('h', 'u', '/my/key', 22)
print('_ssh_base OK')
assert _res_key('/tmp/mykey') == '/tmp/mykey'
try: _res_key(name='__no_such_vpseasy_key__')
except FileNotFoundError as e: assert '__no_such_vpseasy_key__' in str(e)
print('_res_key OK')
```

## Verification helpers

Cloud-init runs asynchronously after `create()` returns. Use
[`wait_ssh()`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#wait_ssh)
to block until the server is reachable, then `check_cloud_init()` to
confirm the bootstrap completed successfully before deploying.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/vedicreader/vpseasy/blob/main/vpseasy/core.py#L389"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### chk_cloud_init

``` python
def chk_cloud_init(
    host, u:str='deploy', k:NoneType=None, name:NoneType=None, key_pass:NoneType=None, password:NoneType=None,
    verbose:bool=True
)->str:
```

*Return cloud-init status: done|running|error|unknown. Uses the
cloud_init_sh() marker in /var/lib/vpseasy when present. check=False
handles exit code 2 (done-with-warnings) on Ubuntu 24.04.*

``` python
    key_pass:NoneType=None, password:NoneType=None, verbose:bool=True
):
```

*Poll SSH until connection succeeds or raises TimeoutError.*

``` python
# chk_docker: returns False when key lookup fails (FileNotFoundError caught internally — no network call)
assert chk_docker('localhost', name='__no_such_vpseasy_key__') is False
print('chk_docker: bad key → False OK')

# wait_ssh: raises TimeoutError immediately when tout=0
try: wait_ssh('1.2.3.4', tout=0); assert False
except TimeoutError as e: assert '1.2.3.4' in str(e)
print('wait_ssh: tout=0 → TimeoutError OK')
```

``` python
    name, # server name (also used for SSH key slug if key not given)

    retries:int=2, # cloud-init retries before giving up and raising TimeoutError
    verbose:bool=True, # whether to print verbose logs during wait and deploy steps
):
```

### vps_deploy

``` python
def vps_deploy(
    name, # server name (also used for SSH key slug if key not given)
    src, # local path to sync and deploy
    provider, # Hetzner(), Lightsail() or anything with get, server_ip and create
    user:str='deploy', # remote username to deploy with (must match cloud-init user)
    key:NoneType=None, # optional SSH private key path or Path object (overrides name-based lookup of ~/.ssh/<name>)
    path:str='/srv/app', # remote path to sync to and deploy at
    build:bool=True, # whether to pass --build to docker compose up
    include:NoneType=None, # rsync include (whitelist) patterns
    exclude:NoneType=None, # rsync exclude (blacklist) patterns
    extra:NoneType=None, # extra rsync flags forwarded to sync() e.g. '--checksum' or ['--ignore-times','--partial']
    key_pass:NoneType=None, # passphrase for the SSH key, if it's encrypted
    password:NoneType=None, # server password for SSH auth (alternative to key-based auth)
    tout:int=600, # seconds to wait for SSH and cloud-init each before retrying (default 10 minutes)
    retries:int=2, # cloud-init retries before giving up and raising TimeoutError
    verbose:bool=True, # whether to print verbose logs during wait and deploy steps
    **create_kw
):
```

*Provision on any provider (idempotent) → wait for cloud-init → deploy.
Returns AttrDict(ip, name, key).*

``` python
@contextmanager
def patch_to_fakes(calls):
    'Replace wait_ready, deploy, vps_init and subprocess with fakes where vps_deploy resolves them, so no key or known_hosts is touched.'
    g = vps_deploy.__globals__
    ks = 'wait_ready', 'deploy', 'vps_init', 'subprocess'
    o = {k: g[k] for k in ks}
    g['wait_ready'] = lambda *a, **k: calls.append(('wait_ready', a, k))
    g['deploy'] = lambda *a, **k: calls.append(('deploy', a, k))
    g['vps_init'] = lambda name, *a, **k: AttrDict(yaml='#cloud-config\n', key='/tmp/k')
    g['subprocess'] = AttrDict(run=lambda *a, **k: calls.append(('ssh-keygen', a, k)))
    try: yield
    finally: g.update(o)

class FakeProvider:
    def __init__(self, made=()): self.made, self.kw = list(made), None
    def get(self, name): return {'name': name} if name in self.made else None
    def server_ip(self, name): return '192.0.2.9'
    def create(self, name, cloud_init=None, **kw): self.made.append(name); self.kw = kw; return AttrDict(ip='192.0.2.9', name=name, key='/tmp/k')

calls, fp = [], FakeProvider()
with patch_to_fakes(calls): r = vps_deploy('svc', '.', fp, verbose=False, bundle='nano_3_0')
test_eq(r, AttrDict(ip='192.0.2.9', name='svc', key='/tmp/k'))
test_eq([c[0] for c in calls], ['ssh-keygen', 'wait_ready', 'deploy'])
test_eq(fp.kw, dict(bundle='nano_3_0'))

# existing server: no create, explicit key used
calls, fp = [], FakeProvider(made=['svc'])
with patch_to_fakes(calls): r = vps_deploy('svc', '.', fp, key='/tmp/other', verbose=False)
test_eq(r, AttrDict(ip='192.0.2.9', name='svc', key='/tmp/other'))
test_eq(fp.kw, None)
```

### Lightsail live test

Skipped unless `VPSEASY_LIVE=1`. Creates a `nano_3_2` instance with
[`vps_init`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#vps_init)
user data, checks the deploy user and Docker came up, creates a bucket
and access key, then deletes the instance, its static IP and the test
bucket. Run with
`VPSEASY_LIVE=1 AWS_PROFILE=<sso profile> uv run nbdev-test --path nbs/00_core.ipynb`.

``` python
if os.environ.get('VPSEASY_LIVE'):
    import secrets
    ln, bn = 'vpseasy-live-test', f'vpseasy-live-test-bkt-{secrets.token_hex(3)}'
    lsl, kp = Lightsail(), gen_key('vpseasy-live-test', key_dir=tempfile.mkdtemp())
    try:
        r = lsl.create(ln, bundle='nano_3_2', cloud_init=vps_init(ln, kp.pub_str), snapshots=None)
        print('instance ip', r.ip)
        wait_ready(r.ip, k=kp.key, tout=600, verbose=True)
        print(run_ssh(r.ip, 'id && docker --version', key=kp.key))
        b = lsl.bucket(bn)
        bk = lsl._c.get_buckets(bucketName=bn)['buckets'][0]
        print('bucket endpoint', b.endpoint, 'reported url', bk['url'], 'location', bk['location'])
    finally:
        lsl.delete(ln)
        with suppress(lsl._c.exceptions.NotFoundException):
            for k in lsl._c.get_bucket_access_keys(bucketName=bn)['accessKeys']:
                lsl._c.delete_bucket_access_key(bucketName=bn, accessKeyId=k['accessKeyId'])
            lsl._c.delete_bucket(bucketName=bn, forceDelete=True)
    test_eq([s for s in lsl.servers() if s['name'] == ln], [])
```

## Docker Compose helpers

[`vols_to_binds()`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#vols_to_binds)
converts absolute container paths to local bind mounts.
[`caddy_stack()`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#caddy_stack)
generates a full production Compose file: `app` + `caddy` + optional
`cloudflared`, `web` network, and caddy volumes — one call replaces the
boilerplate in every FastHTML deploy.

``` python
def caddy_stack(
    domain, df, vols:NoneType=None, env_file:str='.env', cloudflared:bool=True, root:NoneType=None,
    conf:NoneType=None, litestream:NoneType=None, **kw
):
```

*Compose with app + caddy + optional cloudflared and litestream, web
network, caddy volumes.* df: Dockerfile instance. root: if given, saves
Dockerfile + docker-compose.yml there. litestream: dict(dbs, bucket,
endpoint, region, prefix) streams the app’s sqlite dbs to a bucket; a
one-shot litestream-restore service restores missing dbs before app

    services:
      app:
        build: .
        volumes:
        - ./data:/app/data
        env_file:
        - .env
        restart: unless-stopped
        networks:
        - web
      caddy:
        image: caddy:2
        depends_on:
        - app
        volumes:
        - ./Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile
        - caddy_data:/data
        - caddy_config:/config
        networks:
        - web
        restart: unless-stopped
      cloudflared:
        image: cloudflare/cloudflared:latest
        command: tunnel --no-autoupdate run --url http://caddy
        environment:
        - TUNNEL_TOKEN=${CF_TUNNEL_TOKEN}
        networks:
        - web
        restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      web: null
    volumes:
      caddy_data: null
      caddy_config: null

## Litestream

[`litestream_conf()`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#litestream_conf)
writes a Litestream 0.5 config that streams each SQLite db to an
S3-compatible bucket (a
[`Lightsail.bucket()`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#lightsail.bucket),
AWS S3 or Cloudflare R2) under `<prefix>/<db path>`, so dbs with the
same file name never collide. Tested against `litestream/litestream:0.5`
(v0.5.17); note Litestream ignores unknown config keys silently.
[`litestream_svc()`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vpseasy/core.html#litestream_svc)
returns a Litestream service’s `Compose.svc()` kwargs.
`caddy_stack(..., litestream=dict(dbs=..., bucket=..., endpoint=..., region=...))`
wires them in: a one-shot `litestream-restore` service
(`restore -if-db-not-exists -if-replica-exists`) must complete
successfully before `app` starts, so a fresh server gets its db back
before the app can create an empty one; the long-running `litestream`
replicate service starts after `app`. Credentials come from
`LITESTREAM_ACCESS_KEY_ID` / `LITESTREAM_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` in `.env`.
Db paths are container paths and must sit inside one of the app’s
`vols`, otherwise the sidecar would replicate nothing.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/vedicreader/vpseasy/blob/main/vpseasy/core.py#L524"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

``` python
    vols:str='/app/data', conf:str='litestream.yml', env_file:str='.env', image:str='litestream/litestream:0.5',
    cmd:str='replicate', restart:str='unless-stopped', **kw
):
```

*Litestream service kwargs for Compose.svc(): mounts the app volumes
holding the dbs and the config.*

``` python
def litestream_conf(
    dbs, bucket, endpoint:NoneType=None, region:str='auto', prefix:NoneType=None, conf:str='litestream.yml',
    retention:str='72h', snapshot:str='24h', vols:NoneType=None
):
```

*Write a Litestream 0.5 config replicating each sqlite db to an
S3-compatible bucket under prefix/<db path>.*

``` python
_d = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
y = litestream_conf(['/app/data/palana.db'], 'lh-backups', endpoint='https://s3.ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com',
                    region='ap-southeast-2', prefix='littlehours', conf=_d/'litestream.yml')
assert 'replica:' in y and 'replicas:' not in y
assert 'path: littlehours/app/data/palana.db' in y and 'restore-if-db-not-exists' not in y
# same file name in two volumes → distinct replica paths
y3 = litestream_conf(['/app/data/a.db', '/app/cache/a.db'], 'b', conf=_d/'y3.yml')
assert 'path: app/data/a.db' in y3 and 'path: app/cache/a.db' in y3
assert '${LITESTREAM_ACCESS_KEY_ID}' in y and '${LITESTREAM_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}' in y
test_eq((_d/'litestream.yml').read_text(), y)
# R2: region auto, custom endpoint
y2 = litestream_conf(['/app/data/a.db'], 'b', endpoint='https://acct.r2.cloudflarestorage.com', conf=_d/'l.yml')
assert 'region: auto' in y2 and 'endpoint: https://acct.r2.cloudflarestorage.com' in y2
# relative paths, or paths outside the mounted volumes, are configuration mistakes
test_fail(lambda: litestream_conf(['data/a.db'], 'b'), contains='absolute')
test_fail(lambda: litestream_conf(['/tmp/a.db'], 'b', vols=['/app/data'], conf=_d/'x.yml'), contains='/tmp/a.db')
test_fail(lambda: litestream_conf(['/app/database.db'], 'b', vols=['/app/data'], conf=_d/'x.yml'), contains='/app/database.db')

s = litestream_svc()
test_eq(s['image'], 'litestream/litestream:0.5')
test_eq(s['command'], 'replicate')
test_eq(s['volumes'], ['./data:/app/data', './litestream.yml:/etc/litestream.yml'])
test_eq(s['env_file'], ['.env'])
assert 'env_file' not in litestream_svc(env_file=None)
```

``` python
_d = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
ls_kw = dict(dbs=['/app/data/palana.db'], bucket='lh-backups', endpoint='https://s3.ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com', region='ap-southeast-2')
c = caddy_stack('lh.example.com', fasthtml_app(), vols=['/app/data'], root=_d, conf=_d/'Caddyfile', litestream=ls_kw)
d = c.to_dict()
svcs = d['services']
assert {'litestream', 'litestream-restore'} <= set(svcs)
# app waits for the one-shot restore to finish; replicate starts after the app
test_eq(svcs['app']['depends_on'], {'litestream-restore': {'condition': 'service_completed_successfully'}})
test_eq(svcs['litestream-restore']['command'], 'restore -if-db-not-exists -if-replica-exists /app/data/palana.db')
test_eq(svcs['litestream-restore']['restart'], 'no')
test_eq(svcs['litestream']['command'], 'replicate')
test_eq(svcs['litestream']['depends_on'], ['app'])
test_eq(svcs['litestream']['volumes'], ['./data:/app/data', './litestream.yml:/etc/litestream.yml'])
assert (_d/'litestream.yml').exists()
assert "restart: 'no'" in str(c)
# several dbs: one restore service each
d2 = caddy_stack('lh.example.com', fasthtml_app(), vols=['/app/data'], root=_d, conf=_d/'Caddyfile',
                 litestream=ls_kw | dict(dbs=['/app/data/a.db', '/app/data/b.db'])).to_dict()['services']
test_eq(set(d2['app']['depends_on']), {'litestream-restore-app-data-a', 'litestream-restore-app-data-b'})
# db outside the app's volumes is rejected
test_fail(lambda: caddy_stack('lh.example.com', fasthtml_app(), vols=['/app/data'], root=_d, conf=_d/'Caddyfile',
                              litestream=ls_kw | dict(dbs=['/srv/x.db'])), contains='/srv/x.db')
# without litestream nothing changes for existing callers
assert 'depends_on' not in caddy_stack('lh.example.com', fasthtml_app(), vols=['/app/data'], root=_d, conf=_d/'Caddyfile').to_dict()['services']['app']
```

### mv_skill_md

``` python
    dry_run:bool=True, dir:NoneType=None

```

*Copy bundled SKILL.md to .agents/skills/vpseasy/ and
~/.claude/skills/vpseasy/*

``` python
import io, sys, tempfile, os
_d = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
(_d/'SKILL.md').write_text('test-skill')   # provide a src so function doesn't bail early
_saved_cwd = os.getcwd(); os.chdir(_d)
_buf = io.StringIO(); sys.stdout, _saved = _buf, sys.stdout
mv_skill_md(dry_run=True, dir=str(_d))
sys.stdout = _saved; os.chdir(_saved_cwd)
_out = _buf.getvalue()
assert '.agents/skills/vpseasy/SKILL.md' in _out, _out
assert '.claude/skills/vpseasy/SKILL.md' in _out, _out
print('mv_skill_md dry_run OK')
```
